features.name: Application Insights telemetry integration
features.description: Ability to connect Business Central online environments to Application Insights by configuring a connection string in the tenant admin center, allowing the environment to emit telemetry data.
caveats: Enabling this triggers an environment restart
Should not be done during working hours

features.name: Connection string configuration UI
features.description: A settings menu in the tenant admin center environment details that allows users to define and paste an Application Insights connection string to enable telemetry data emission.

quotes.text: To enable telemetry for a Business Central online environment, you go to the tenant admin center and pick the environment.
quotes.why_it_matters: States the fundamental process for enabling telemetry, establishing where users start the configuration.

quotes.text: in the details menu here, I have an ability to set application insights connection string.
quotes.why_it_matters: Identifies the specific UI location where the connection string setting is found in the tenant admin center.
